package.name: shoulder_centerline
package.description: Ego-relative shoulder centerline waypoint generation: paints the live LiDAR point cloud with shoulder_detection_node's 2D shoulder mask (PointPainting-style semantic fusion), bins/fits/resamples the resulting ego-frame points into arclength-spaced waypoints with heading and curvature. Pure C++/Eigen/OpenCV geometry node, no learned model of its own, kept separate from the Python model-inference package for speed.
